# NEX — Neural Execution Language

NEX is a checked programming language and toolchain for humans and LLMs.
Current source development 0.162.1 selects ordinary source language 0.28 with
runtime function/loop contracts. The qualified Mac 0.162.0 archive keeps its exact
versioned acceptance. The 0.162.1 source evidence is separate; matching SDK delivery
is pending. The
current Windows/Linux and broader hardware delivery retain separate gates.
Executables run without an LLM. Precise semantics and small retrieved contexts are design goals;
end-to-end model-token savings remain unmeasured.

Use `nex describe --kind index --json`, then `--field PATH --json`.
Use `nex context --symbol NAME --json` for bounded project context.
For native hosts, source development 0.160 supplies bounded
[`native_entry_abi`](docs/native-entry-abi.md) in library build JSON. Retrieve the
actual physical signature and hidden error output; a symbol name alone is not
a host prototype. Discover availability in the selected compiler first.
The selected compiler and actual tests govern support. PLAN and historical
experiments are not implemented capability lists. Windows/CUDA has earlier
versioned evidence; current platform qualification, Metal compute, Apple NPU
and general GPU compilation remain open work.
